name: comfyui-touch-shim
description: Small stopgap mobile/touch QOL fixes for upstream ComfyUI frontend bugs — each shim toggleable via a setting, linked to its upstream issue, and deleted once fixed upstream. TypeScript source in src/, built to web/dist/ via bun build. See ADR-0001.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --target browser --format esm --banner '/* web/dist bundle built by bun from src/ in this repository (see package.json). No third-party code is bundled. */' --outdir web/dist --external '/scripts/*'
